result.title: TyphoonWorld: A Residual Token World Model for Probabilistic Forecasting of Typhoon Imagery
result.summary: A satellite forecast of a typhoon should give a low-error picture of the next two days, together with an ensemble whose members are coherent fields and whose spread responds to the storm at hand. A small direct regression network already gives the lowest squared error on held-out storms, so a generative model has to earn its cost through the part of the future that the regression smooths away. We present TyphoonWorld, a discrete-token world model that generates only that part. Conditioned on tokens of the regression forecast, the latest frames and the best-track state at forecast time, it samples residual fields lead by lead, and members add these residuals to the regression center. We compare it under one protocol with per-pixel Gaussian networks, a diffusion model of the same residuals, residuals from other storms and an unconditional token world model, on 276 forecast windows from 46 held-out storms of Digital Typhoon. TyphoonWorld matches the squared error of the regression, lowers the CRPS of the area colder than 220 K, a direct measure of deep convection, by 14 to 39% against every other ensemble, and ties its spread to forecast error as closely as the Gaussian network, with a correlation of 0.78 across windows. It uses 56% of the parameters of the unconditional world model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TyphoonWorld，一个离散 token 世界模型：以回归预报、最新帧和最佳路径状态为条件，逐 lead 采样残差场，集成成员将残差加回回归中心，用于台风卫星影像的概率预报，并在 276 个预报窗口上与高斯网络、扩散模型等对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 「确定性回归中心 + 学习残差 token」的状态分解，以及用 spread-误差相关性（0.78）检验集成不确定性是否校准，可能为 latent 状态更新中的残差建模与 latent 不确定性评价提供可核查的表述线索，但与 VLM 推理本身距离较远。
